description: Kaiten is a work management and collaboration platform with boards, cards, users, comments, files, and webhooks. Its public developer site documents a REST API for integrating with Kaiten data and automation.
summary: kaiten.ru exposes a bearer-authenticated REST API at `https://kaiten.ru/api/latest`; Kaiten’s broader platform docs also describe authenticated GraphQL, OFREP, and MCP interfaces on the separate `kaiten.sh` platform domain.
